newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT holding firm an option--Posts Minister quoted.
newsitem.headline: NTT holding firm an option--Posts Minister quoted.

text.p: Splitting Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp under a holding company is an option, Japan's Post and Telecommunications Minister Hisao Horinouchi was quoted by Jiji news agency as saying on Tuesday.
Jiji reported that the minister said discussions on splitting NTT should not focus only on the holding company scheme.

"The fact that we do not yet have a holding company system (in Japan) will be one of the hurdles that must be overcome before the scheme becomes possible," the minister was quoted by the news agency as saying.
The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday that the government and NTT had reached a compromise deal on a new structure for the company.
Under the agreement, it said, a holding company would be set up to control three units of NTT -- a long-distance operator and two regional firms -- by the end of March 1999.

A Posts Ministry official said on Monday that the ministry was seeking an early conclusion on a possible NTT breakup, but declined to confirm the report. An NTT spokesman said, meanwhile, that an agreement was expected in December.
